added_failures_note: Derived from completed baseline_suite and after_suite logs and cross-checked against every paired file receipt; the deliberate shared-step mutant is excluded and confirms the failure parser sees a known failure.

assertion_analysis.failure_condition: x64 remains disabled after configuration; independent runtime configuration check.

Scalar and uniform independent drives disagree on certification, moments, reached drive, aggregate updates, reads or number of sub-solves; changing the lane schedule or predictor while retaining scalar behavior reddens the comparison.
A uniform lane has a different requested drive or adaptive step from the scalar driver; changing the lane growth or accepted history reddens it.
One driver fails to certify, or the first attempt fails to accept only the easy lane; reinstating whole-batch acceptance changes the expected literal [True,False].
Easy and stiff lanes do not independently grow and shrink after the mixed result; the recorded shared-step mutation makes line 125 fail with actual 0.005 versus expected 0.02.
The easy lane arrives no sooner than the scalar shared driver; forcing common acceptance or a common minimum step removes the earlier arrival.
The easy lane is requested away from 1.03 or takes updates after certifying; failing to hold a finished lane can redden these independent literal/zero checks.

Distinct-direction lanes fail certification, reach the wrong targets, solve to wrong moments, or report residual above the independent 1e-10 bound; broadcasting one lane target or using loose terminal acceptance reddens these assertions.
A zero-span lane prevents certification or is updated; changing stationary-lane active handling reddens the checks.

Wrong lane profiles in the residual or first Newton booking prevent convergence or yield moments differing from [0.25,-0.75]; the target input is also the expected root but is not merely echoed by the solver, so wrong lane mapping would fail; cached-factor profile mistakes are unguarded because exact Newton terminates after one update.

Rejected first attempts certify, move the accepted drive, expose trial moments, or retain converged flags; reverting the accumulator initialization makes the moments equality fail, as rejected-state-red.log records; the toy support equals the input and therefore cannot detect support leakage.
Double precision is disabled or the process runs off GPU; independent runtime checks.
The driver fails certification, any lane reports unconverged, or the reported terminal residual exceeds 1e-10; weakening final acceptance can violate these bounds.
The archived first attempt no longer exhibits an easy success and stiff failure, no whole-batch rejection occurs, or the following shared step is not shrunk; this protects the reproduction premise.

Arms use different seed/bank/step/target hashes, or a physical ratio violates a locked bound without being refused; each ratio is separately mutated above its bound and the refusal set must equal the four known quantities.

An arm is incomplete or uncertified, has other than eight finite sub-tolerance residuals, or aggregate count totals disagree with independently summed per-call rows; fabricated zero counts conflict with the recorded positive rows.

Mutation marker is absent/ambiguous, mutant unexpectedly passes or records no failure, a paired suite is incomplete or adds an ID, or the new file fails; known shared-step red log confirms nonempty failure parsing.
Refreshed driver files fail or are incomplete, the mutation cannot be placed uniquely, or the shared-step control passes/has no failure ID.

Reconstructed accepted trajectories do not end at the supplied target, reproduction/allocation logs lack EXIT=0, CPU receipts are incomplete/nonzero, the mutant is not red, or the first measured row was rejected; these prevent publication of incomplete or mismatched evidence.

assertion_independence_note: No added test assertion is an unconditional input echo: root equalities test actual Newton results, and drive equalities test accepted continuation progress; growth and shrink equations test relationships between successive measured steps, not the mere configured constant. Missing support variation and cached-factor execution are explicit findings.

findings.text: blocking: The initial accumulator copies attempt.support from the first trial and replaces only moments, residual and converged; if that lane rejects every attempt and stops at the floor or ceiling, result.support.stationary and result.support.reading still describe a rejected target trial while result.moments and drive describe the incumbent, violating retained-state consistency; preserve an incumbent support or explicitly represent its absence, and test a rejected solver that changes stationary positions and readings.

non-blocking: run duplicates the fresh-process execution, provenance logging, exit capture and receipt parsing owned by scripts/prototypes/bank_warm_predictor/suites.py:43; it neither wraps nor extends that owner, so fixes to completion or failure parsing now require changes in two places; extend the owner for absolute commands and environment overrides and call it here.

non-blocking: Both reuse parameter cases converge in one exact profile-minus-state update, so have_factor is false on their only iteration and one_with_factor is never executed; a wrong lane profile in the changed cached-factor branch at support_read.py:1846 would leave this test green, so require multiple contracting updates and observe the cached branch.
